beacon.question: How many lights would fill a 100×100 square?

lens.name: Square Growth Lens
lens.discoverySentence: Each next odd number grows a square by one outer layer.
lens.power: It sees 1 + 3 + 5 + ... + (2n - 1) as an n×n square.

actions.meaning: Grow from (k - 1)×(k - 1) to k×k by adding one L-shaped shell.
Apply the shell-growth Lens to the 100×100 light plaza.

boundary.reason: These sequences do not add exactly one L-shaped shell of size 2k - 1 at every step.

successSentence: I found that each next odd number grows a square by one outer layer.
